facts.fact: Public Eye reports that the CAFI Lesotho Entrepreneurship Hub and Seed Financing Facility, funded by the World Bank through the government's CAFI project, awarded US$7,000 (M134,675.80) seed funding each to 10 enterprises.

facts.fact: Public Eye reports that Limkokwing University's LEAP incubator ran a six-month incubation programme for 10 enterprises, one of five CAFI-trained enterprise support organisations including NUL Innovation Hub, BEDCO, TEN and Gem Institute.
